title: Ground initial development in simulation and the planned leg stand
summary: James clarified that the physical hexapod is unbuilt, Mid-360 is unmounted and current development is simulation-only. A planned leg stand with force sensing and an encoder will supply measured data for sim-to-real calibration. The first mapping test uses a stationary simulated Mid-360 view of known geometry; physical sensing and full-robot qualification remain later work. No experiment is launched.
next: Define the smallest simulated stationary-scan fixture and acceptance criteria using the existing sensor implementation as the starting point.
